label: Druid
content: Day 1, before the first seeds are even chosen. The Pea family is already judging my card picks.

label: Pea Waifu
content: Sunflower first, druid. ALWAYS Sunflower first. Then me. Then we fuse and become Sunshooter.

label: Sunflower Waifu
content: Trophy! You picked up the trophy and you still came back to gloat. Twin Sunflower approves.

label: Druid
content: Level 2 tomorrow. Something red is coming.

label: Druid
content: Day 2. The Cherry Bomb is awake. She is a one-use plant. She does NOT do encores.

label: Cherry Waifu
content: I am a single, perfect explosion. Point me at the biggest crowd you have.

label: Cherry Waifu
content: Level clear. I exploded beautifully and I would like a nap now.

label: Druid
content: Day 3. Wall-nut has volunteered to be the front row. Forever. He has no choice, he is a wall.

label: Wall Waifu
content: I will hold the line. Probably. Do not think about my health bar.

label: Wall Waifu
content: We survived! The Shrooms are next — they only come out at night, and Doom and Ice are watching from the roof.

label: Druid
content: Three Adventure levels down. The druid story continues in the fog.
